source: Bluesky 2025 Transparency Report, published by Bluesky on 29 January 2026

labels_total.quote: In 2025, Bluesky applied 16.49M labels across both accounts and individual pieces of content — a 200% increase from 2024's 5.5M labels.

labels_total_overview.quote: We maintained 24/7 moderation coverage, reviewed 9.97 million user reports, applied 16.49 million labels, and removed 2.45 million pieces of violating content.

top_labels_table.quote: Top Labels Label Category Total Applied % Applied Manually adult 10.79M 1% suggestive 3.42M 3% spam 761.77K 1% nudity 389.44K 18% needs-review 370.14K 0% rude 295.38K 100% sexual-figurative 152.58K 0% graphic-media 127.46K 3% !hide 68.26K 2% intolerant 60.20K 100% self-harm 20.92K 8% threat 15.86K 100%

adult_detection.quote: While automation handles high-confidence signals (14.2M labels for adult content detection alone) human moderators concentrate on assessments requiring cultural competency and contextual understanding.

adult_vs_takedowns.quote: Adult content generated 14.2M labels compared to less than 2K takedowns, since consensual adult content is allowed on Bluesky with proper labeling.

content_share.quote: In 96.57% of cases, we label specific content rather than marking entire accounts.

level_shares.quote: Categories like intolerance (98% at the content-level and 2% account-level), threat (100% content-level), and rude (99% content-level) target individual posts because one problematic post doesn't define an entire account.

needs_review_account.quote: Our operational label (needs-review) works exclusively at the account level by design.

needs_review_count.quote: Applied automatically to combat large-scale spam attacks and bulk abuse patterns (370.14K accounts in 2025).

automated_share.quote: The majority of labels applied (95.34%) come from automated systems.

takedowns_items.quote: In 2025, we removed 2,446,334 items, covering both accounts and content.

account_takedowns.quote: At the same time, account takedowns grew just 104% (from 1.02M to 2.08M).

temporary_suspensions.quote: We issued 13,192 temporary suspensions in 2025, with 69% lasting 24 hours, 29% lasting 72 hours, and just 2% extending to seven days.

reports.quote: In 2025, users submitted 9.97M reports (a 54% increase from 2024's 6.48M reports).
